user_preference: Future image-fusion evaluations use the implementations in IVIF_ZOO/Metric.
reference_preprocessing: IVIF_ZOO/Metric/eval_torch.py: PIL grayscale, uint8 then torch.float32, no crop or resize
adapter: GMFF/ivif_reference_metrics.py: executes the selected reference function bodies without rewriting their formulas
PI_exception: IVIF_ZOO has no PI. Continue the separately labeled pyiqa==0.1.13 PerceptualIndex with crop_border=4 on CPU, as documented in GMFF/fusion_metrics.py.
aggregation: Unweighted mean over pairs; population standard deviation when reported
nonfinite_policy: Fail and report undefined reference scores; never replace them with zero
historical_results: Keep existing results and their original protocol labels. This preference applies to future evaluations.
paper_alignment: This toolbox is not established as the private evaluator used for Mask-DiFuser's paper tables. Model inference settings remain method-specific.
